label: 侧卧托头
pose_lead: Grounded pose, side-lying with the head propped on one hand:
lower_limbs: Both legs bend and stack along one side of the body, the knees pointing forward or slightly up.
upper_limbs: One hand props the head with the elbow on the ground; the other forearm rests on the ground in front of the chest for support.
torso_head: The torso lies on its side but the chest opens slightly toward the front of the frame; the head tilts toward the supporting hand.
weight_silhouette: Weight rests on the side hip, the side leg and the elbow; the figure forms a classic reclining triangle.
